contexts.title: Community Events
contexts.definition: Vocabulary for the public and member gatherings an organization runs (workshops, class sessions, meetups, tours, open houses) and the people who sign up for them: schedules, capacity, fees, age limits, venues, hosts and the registrations that track who paid and who attended.

contexts.title: Learning Programs
contexts.definition: Vocabulary for structured, non-degree learning offered by community organizations such as makerspaces, libraries and arts centers: multi-step programs that lead to a skill or badge, booked one-on-one sessions with a facilitator, knowledge checks that gate a badge, and tutorials or videos that teach a tool or technique.

concepts.definition: A scheduled gathering that an organization runs for the public or its members, such as a hands-on workshop, one run of a class, a meetup, a facility tour or an open house. It carries a type, one or more dated sessions, a venue or online link, capacity and registration window, fees, age and skill limits, and the hosts who lead it.

fields.name: identifier
fields.description: Stable id of the event

fields.name: summary
fields.description: Short teaser

fields.name: eventType
fields.description: CiviCRM event_type_id; workshop..performance from CiviCRM defaults, the rest from a makerspace's event bundles

fields.name: isPublic
fields.description: Listed in public calendars

fields.name: sessions
fields.description: Start datetime of every meeting, first included, for multi-session runs

fields.name: onlineJoinUrl
fields.description: Meeting link sent only to registrants

fields.name: capacity
fields.description: Maximum participants (CiviCRM max_participants)

fields.name: isPaid
fields.description: CiviCRM is_monetary

fields.name: feeDescription
fields.description: Ticket types and prices as shown to registrants

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217

fields.name: ageRequirement
fields.description: Minimum age or age band, e.g. 18+, 13+ with guardian

fields.name: topics
fields.description: Subject areas

fields.name: hosts
fields.description: Instructors or on-site leads

fields.name: partnerOrganizations
fields.description: Co-hosting or sponsoring organizations

fields.name: badgesAwarded
fields.description: Badges participants earn on completion

fields.name: course
fields.description: The learning-programs Course this event is one run of (schema:CourseInstance)

fields.name: parentEvent
fields.description: Enclosing event for sub-events

fields.name: materials
fields.description: Links to slides, notes, worksheets

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Core fields from CiviCRM Event (title, summary, description, event_type_id, is_public, is_active, start_date, end_date, is_online_registration, registration_link_text, registration_start_date, registration_end_date, max_participants, has_waitlist, requires_approval, is_monetary, currency, loc_block_id, parent_event_id) and its default event types; makerspace additions from the website config: config/field.field.civicrm_event.*.field_civi_event_* (capacity, registered/remaining counts, full, sessions, instructor, staff contact, age requirement, area of interest, badges, documents, recording, parent course, skill level) and the archived config/node.type.event.yml (date range, location, partner, price, registration link, join link, terms). schema.org Event/EducationEvent/CourseInstance cross-checked.

concepts.definition: One person's sign-up for a scheduled gathering, linking that person to it with a role (attendee, volunteer, host, speaker), a lifecycle status from registered or waitlisted through attended, no-show or cancelled, the fee level and amount paid, and who registered them. CiviCRM records it as a Participant.

fields.name: event
fields.description: The Community Event

fields.name: source
fields.description: How the registration came in (online form, back office, import)

fields.name: feeLevel
fields.description: Ticket or price option chosen

fields.name: registeredBy
fields.description: Person who registered on the participant's behalf

fields.name: birthDate
fields.description: Collected at registration to enforce age limits

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from CiviCRM Participant (id, contact_id, event_id, status_id, role_id, register_date, source, fee_level, fee_amount, fee_currency, discount_amount, is_pay_later, registered_by_id, transferred_to_contact_id); status values from civicrm_participant_status_type.sqldata.php, roles from option group participant_role. The website stores participants in CiviCRM (no Drupal fields); its modules makehaven_event_capacity, instructor_companion and makerspace_workshops_dashboard read event_id, contact_id, status_id, register_date and source, and makerspace_event_registration collects date of birth on the registration form.

concepts.definition: A reusable offering of structured instruction (a workshop, a multi-session program, a badge class) that is run repeatedly as dated sessions. It describes what is taught in ordered units and steps, how many meetings one run has, who may enrol, which skill badges completing it grants and what to take next.

fields.name: offeringMode
fields.description: How runs are offered right now

fields.name: sessionCount
fields.description: Meetings per run; 1 for a single workshop

fields.name: units
fields.description: Ordered units, each {title, steps[{stepType: content|video|quiz|resources|badge|project, instructions, contentUrl}]}

fields.name: badgesAwarded
fields.description: schema:educationalCredentialAwarded

fields.name: finalAssessment
fields.description: The Skill Assessment taken at the end

fields.name: nextCourses
fields.description: Suggested follow-on offerings

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from the website's config/node.type.course.yml and config/field.field.node.course.* (course type, status, publicly listed, member only, offering mode, session count/interval/names, units, badges, final exam, next steps, required assets, instructor expertise, payment amount/type, materials) and the course unit/step paragraphs (config/paragraphs.paragraphs_type.course_unit*.yml); schema.org Course (educationalCredentialAwarded, hasCourseInstance) for the badge and run relations. Runs are Community Events linked by field_parent_course.

concepts.definition: A booked time window in which a facilitator meets one person or a small group for hands-on learning, a practical tool checkout that grants a badge, a consultation or project help. It records who hosts and attends, the purpose and badges at stake, how it was requested and confirmed, whether the facilitator showed up on time, and the outcome.

fields.name: badges
fields.description: Badges the attendee hopes to earn

fields.name: requestNote
fields.description: What the attendee wants help with

fields.name: feedback
fields.description: Facilitator's written feedback

fields.name: isOnRequest
fields.description: Time proposed by the attendee rather than taken from published availability

fields.name: openToOthers
fields.description: Other eligible people may join

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from the website's config/node.type.appointment.yml and config/field.field.node.appointment.* (host, attendees, date/time range, purpose, badges, status, result, note, feedback, on-request, open to join, facilitator arrival status/time, counter-proposal), with behaviour from custom modules appointment_facilitator, appointment_on_request and appointment_enhancements. Calendly-booked tours/orientations (calendly_to_civicrm) land as CiviCRM activities, not appointments.

concepts.definition: A scored set of questions (multiple choice, true/false, matching) that checks what a learner knows before granting a skill badge or unlocking a practical checkout. It defines the pass mark, attempts allowed, time limit and availability window, the questions and answer keys, and feedback shown for score ranges.

fields.name: maxAttempts
fields.description: 0 = unlimited

fields.name: randomQuestionCount
fields.description: Questions drawn at random per attempt, if any

fields.name: questions
fields.description: Each {questionType: multiple_choice|true_false|matching|directions, prompt, choices[{text, isCorrect, feedback}], correctAnswer, pairs[{prompt, answer}]}

fields.name: resultFeedback
fields.description: Each {minScore, maxScore, feedback}

fields.name: grantsBadge
fields.description: Badge granted or moved to pending checkout on passing

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from the Drupal Quiz module entity as configured on the website (config/core.entity_form_display.quiz.quiz.default.yml: title, body, status, pass_rate, takes, time_limit, quiz_open, quiz_close, quiz_always, number_of_random_questions, allow_resume, allow_skipping, result_options), its question bundles (config/field.field.quiz_question.*: multichoice alternatives, truefalse_correct, matching pairs) and paragraphs (multichoice, quiz_matching, quiz_result_feedback); badge link from config/field.field.taxonomy_term.badges.field_badge_quiz_reference.yml and the assign_badge_from_quiz module. Anchored to schema.org Quiz.

concepts.definition: A piece of instructional material, usually a video, guide or document, that teaches how to use a tool or perform a technique, often attached to a machine or a badge. It has a title, a link, a format, a transcript and timestamped chapters, and says what equipment or skills it covers.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Instructions or summary shown with it

fields.name: chapters
fields.description: Each {label, offsetSeconds or url with timestamp}

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from the website's config/field.field.paragraph.tool_video.* (video title, URL, transcript, timestamp links; attached to equipment via node.item.field_item_videos) and the course video/HTML step paragraphs (instructions, video URL, content); schema.org LearningResource (learningResourceType, educationalLevel, teaches) and VideoObject (transcript, hasPart Clip) for the rest.
